paper_type_evidence.quote: We present four daytime thermal images of Europa taken with the Atacama Large Millimeter Array.

question.value: What causes the large-scale daytime thermal structure of Europa, and do surface thermal properties (thermal inertia) vary spatially?

evidence.quote: We use a global thermal model of Europa to simulate the ALMA observations in order to investigate the thermal structure visible in the data.
